title: The Power of Precommitments
coreMove: Make the desired future choice before temptation arrives, while the calmer self can still set the rules.
sourcePressure: The chapter introduces pacts as future-facing constraints used when present-moment intention repeatedly loses.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A weak run would use precommitments as punishment or as the first tool before internal triggers and traction are handled.

hook: The Power of Precommitments as a labeled topic opener
counterintuition: phones are not the problem by itself
tryThisNow: set a timer and notice your distractions
examples: reused old-package object-anchor shell from earlier Indistractable run

exampleSpecs.domain: night-shift radiology resident protecting sleep after call
exampleSpecs.audience: resident who keeps extending awake time with videos
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before the shift, she gives her streaming password to a roommate until noon sleep ends
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A sealed password card sits beside a post-call sleep sign.

exampleSpecs.domain: freelance translator avoiding news during morning translation
exampleSpecs.audience: translator whose current-event checking breaks flow
exampleSpecs.stakes: client delivery depends on the first uninterrupted page
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: the night before, he schedules a site blocker for the first translation block
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A bilingual glossary lies beside a timed blocker receipt.

exampleSpecs.domain: bakery co-owner resisting cash-register snacks after closing
exampleSpecs.audience: owner who eats from leftover trays during cleanup
exampleSpecs.stakes: health goal loses to one tired closing ritual
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: before, she negotiates each night; after, leftovers go into sealed donation crates before cleanup starts
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A donation crate label rests beside a locked pastry case key.

exampleSpecs.domain: graduate archivist protecting thesis writing from late-night browsing
exampleSpecs.audience: student who has handled triggers but still loses the same hour
exampleSpecs.stakes: thesis deadline needs a constraint stronger than preference
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she sets the router timer before dinner so the writing hour starts without negotiation
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A router timer sits beside an archive index card.

exampleSpecs.domain: competitive archer avoiding equipment tinkering before practice
exampleSpecs.audience: athlete who keeps adjusting gear instead of shooting reps
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: he locks spare adjustment tools in the coach box before stepping to the line
exampleSpecs.firstImage: An Allen key pouch is sealed beside a target-face roll.

exampleSpecs.domain: choir treasurer avoiding budget review after rehearsals
exampleSpecs.audience: volunteer who drifts into social chat at the exact review time
exampleSpecs.stakes: late invoices damage trust with the venue
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: she arranges a partner check-in call five minutes after rehearsal ends
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A venue invoice lies beside a scheduled check-in card.
